body.para: Sorts the records of the current table and writes the result to a new table. This is the FoxPro version of the SORT command.

SORT TO <TableName> ON <Field1> [/A | /D] [/C] [, <Field2> [/A | /D] [/C] ...]
[ASCENDING | DESCENDING]
[<Scope>] [FOR <lCondition>] [WHILE <lCondition>] [NOOPTIMIZE]
[FIELDS <FieldList> | FIELDS LIKE <Skeleton> | FIELDS EXCEPT <Skeleton>]
TO <TableName>The name of the table that receives the sorted records.
ON <Field1> [/A | /D] [/C], ...The fields on which the table is sorted. /A sorts ascending (default), /D sorts descending and /C ignores the case of character fields.
ASCENDING | DESCENDINGThe default direction for the fields that have no /A or /D option.
NOOPTIMIZEDisables the optimization of the FOR clause.
The FoxPro version of the command adds the FIELDS clause with the LIKE and EXCEPT options, which limits the fields that are written to the new table.

USE Customers
SORT TO SortedCustomers ON Country, LastName /C FOR Active
SORT TO Names ON LastName FIELDS LastName, FirstName
